Process

How It Works

Simple, secure, and straightforward from first contact to final delivery.

01
Contact & Photos
Send us photos or details of your key, fob, card, or access credential. We'll confirm compatibility at no charge.
02
Compatibility Check
We verify the format, technology, and encoding requirements — and confirm the service options available to you.
03
Local or Mail-In
Drop off locally in Honolulu or ship your key to us. Secure, insured handling throughout the process.
04
Receive Your Duplicate
Your duplicate access credentials are returned promptly with full quality verification included.

Authorized Use Only
KeyWave provides key duplication and NFC/RFID programming services exclusively for legally owned and authorized access credentials. All services are intended for backup creation, replacement of lost credentials, property management, access administration, business automation, and authorized smart-tag configuration. We reserve the right to decline any request that cannot be verified as authorized access administration. By requesting service, you confirm that you are the authorized owner or administrator of the credentials being duplicated or programmed.
